records.title: Naziha
records.meta: TV drama serial · Malaysia · Malay · TV3 Slot Zehra · 13 episodes (15 Jun – 14 Sep 2012) · Orangetree Production · dir. Along Kamaludin
records.character: Naziha (Izara Aishah); husband Farouk (Erry Putra); former fiancé Adam (Ryzal Jaafar); later suitor Akmal (Amar Baharin)
records.summary: Naziha rejects Farouk in public, and he swears to get her by any means. Slander wrecks her planned wedding to her childhood friend Adam days before the ceremony, so to cover the shame she is pushed into marrying Farouk. As his wife she is abused physically and mentally by a husband who practises black magic (ilmu hitam) to subdue her. In the finale Naziha agrees to marry Akmal; Farouk attacks the wedding party on the way to the mosque and stabs Adam, who dies.
records.note: Controller: her husband Farouk (black magic used to 'menakluk' — conquer/subdue — her). Loose fit: the sources say he uses black magic to subdue and torment her but do not spell out a trance or will-override scene. Age is not stated; she is an adult bride in the cited synopses. Pregnancy not mentioned.

episodes.gist: Forced marriage to Farouk, who uses black magic to subdue her (Malay Wikipedia, Budiey).
Naziha agrees to marry Akmal; Farouk stabs Adam on the way to the mosque and Adam dies (Admya episode recap).

records.kids_together_note: No children with Farouk are mentioned in the cited sources.
records.kids_note: No prior children; she is a first-time bride.
records.married_note: Forced to marry Farouk after the slander; by the finale she agrees to marry Akmal.
